declared_limits: A client-sent X-Forwarded-Host (and Forwarded / X-Forwarded-For / -Proto) line is still forwarded as a client header, ahead of the proxy's own X-Forwarded-Host; dropping them belongs to SEC-PROXY-002 (wave-19). Not fixed here.
A single Host line with a comma-list or otherwise unusual value is forwarded as-is (only several Host lines answer 400, as the SRS states).
Test helpers ConnectionCounter/exchange/tinyHttpdProxy are duplicated again in ProxyHostHeaderTest (5th copy); extracting a shared test-support class needs edits outside this lane's write set.
D-051 null-message shape of the 400 is implemented (plain HttpException(400)) but not asserted beyond the status.
